message: SABDHAM 1.2.3 is required. Update now for the cleaner Home top bar, smarter search queue, playlist discovery fixes and improved playlist click actions.
releaseNotes: Cleaner compact Home top bar with improved spacing and less visual clutter.
Search-result playback queues related songs by matching language and genre while excluding repeated titles.
Playlist search zero-result cases fixed with stronger public playlist discovery.
Playlist card tap, three-dot menu, Add to Queue and provider-specific actions are more reliable.
